rootReadme: Read system/README.md or system/README.ru.md for the selected language and verify the matching native kit before any command.
rootAgent: Read system/BOOTSTRAP.md or system/locales/ru/BOOTSTRAP.md. This unpacked installation folder is not initialized until the native install command succeeds; a permanent coordinator is assigned only by explicit current selection.
syncReadme: OCMI Sync contains selected coordinator data. Personal memory is created only after a separate user choice after role handover; local machine state is not synchronized.
coordinatorAgent: Read INDEX.md, HANDOFF.md and <GUIDE_RELATIVE> before acting. Current client binding is confirmed by a client tool or user; the native command records that report and does not prove it.
coordinatorIndex: Selected coordinator memory. Continuation is stored here; verify current local handover before optional actions.
coordinatorHandoff: Optional actions are not selected. Continuation is stored here; current handover state is local.
